notes: `שֶׁמֶן` is rightly unrepresented rather than folded into *olive trees*: rule 31 puts the lexeme of `זַיִת` on *olive* and makes *trees* the supplied generic, so no English word carries the sense of the oil and rule 30's condition is unmet.
*fig trees* and *olive trees* head on *fig* and *olive* by rule 31's subtraction test, the generic noun alone naming any tree.
